questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All books are red.

2. No copy is red.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are copies.

II. No book Is a copy.

III. All the copies are books.
questions.solution:
Given:

**Statements:**

1. All books are red.

2. No copy is red.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebb6178c3a73f9e6747739babddbfe9643d329f10e7332d79597fd7b08b52351.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are copies → False (It is not possible because all books are red and no red is a copy so some books are copies it is not possible)

II. No book Is a copy → True (because all books are red and no red is a copy so no book is a copy)

III. All the copies are books → False (It is not possible because all books are red and no red is a copy so all copies are books it is not possible)

Hence, **only conclusion II follows.**

questions.question:
Select the option that shows the interchange of signs, which when made will give a correct equation.

11 + 4 - 3 ÷ 3 × 7 = 8
questions.solution:
According to the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b58774e01647a1dce8585af0b0e3da55f676e12ce10b27c06a6c9935db9f0739.png] 

**Option 1 :** × and ÷

Given:

11 + 4 - 3 ÷ 3 × 7 = 8

After interchange the signs;

11 + 4 - 3 × 3 ÷ 7 = 8

By BODMAS rule

11 + 4 – 3 × 0.43 = 8

11 + 4 – 1.29 = 8

15 – 1.29 = 8

13.71 = 8 (LHS ≠ RHS)

**Option 2 : **+ and ÷

Given:

11 + 4 - 3 ÷ 3 × 7 = 8

After interchange the signs;

11 ÷ 4 - 3 + 3 × 7 = 8

By BODMAS rule

2.75 – 3 + 3 × 7 = 8

2.75 – 3 + 21 = 8

23.75 - 3 = 8

15.75 = 8 (LHS ≠ RHS)

**Option 3 :** **- and ×**

**Given:**

**11 + 4 - 3 ÷ 3 × 7 = 8**

**After interchange the signs;**

**11 + 4 × 3 ÷ 3 - 7 = 8**

**By BODMAS rule**

**11 + 4 × 1 - 7 = 8**

**11 + 4 – 7 = 8**

**15 – 7 = 8**

**8 = 8 (LHS = RHS)**

**Option 4 :** + and ×

Given:

11 + 4 - 3 ÷ 3 × 7 = 8

After interchange the signs;

11 × 4 - 3 ÷ 3 + 7 = 8

By BODMAS rule

11 × 4 - 1 + 7 = 8

44 - 1 + 7 = 8

51 – 1 = 8

50 = 8 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, the answer is **“****- and ×****”**.

questions.question:
Which of the following figures can be removed so that all, starting from I, fit into a pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae285cd4eb45ceb8a83b5058578b85a23f83add86f4bce9bb766c52acb07fbc5.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed is:

i) In the 1st, 2nd and 4th figures, the plus sign (+) is shifting next box in each figure.

ii) In the 1st, 2nd and 4th figures, the minus sign (-) is shifting next top box (moving clockwise direction) in each figure.

iii) In the 1st, 2nd and 4th figures, the divide sign (÷) is shifted next 2 steps in anticlockwise direction,

Thus we are getting I figure to II figure, II figure to III figure and IV figure to V figure but not getting III figure to IV figure.

Thus the image 1st, 2nd and 4th images are similar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1c2d35bd3bf82847172884d011771cece0dded06677101b4fb52884d9ca4723.png] 

Except for the third, all the others are following the pattern to their next image.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

Two statements are given followed by two conclusions. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All mothers are women.

2. Some women are doctors.

**Conclusions:**

I. No mother is a doctor.

II. Some mothers are doctors.
questions.solution:
Given:

**Statements:**

1. All mothers are women.

2. Some women are doctors.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eea5c8a2e90151f78b64a4e66f2c427ad468b764b4e0d74048ada6b471630e87.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No mother is a doctor → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some mothers are doctors → False (It is possible but not definite)

Both **conclusions I and II form a complementary pair, hence either I or II follows.**

Hence, **"either conclusion I or conclusion II follows" **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

A set of two conclusions is said to be a** Complementary Pair** and thus form a case of **either or** when they follow the following conditions-

i) Both the objects must be the same in both conclusions.

ii) Both the conclusions must be False individually.

Some of the cases of complementary pairs are-

Some + No & All + Some Not 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__****Some + Some not** is **never **a complimentary pair.
